data.notes: As of the search, most Las Vegas club/residency calendars for June 2027 are not yet specifically announced; only confirmed genre/diaspora destination events with dated source pages are included.

events.title: John Mayer Live at Sphere
events.summary: Representative June date for John Mayer's Sphere residency, with the official tour page listing June 2, 4 and 5, 2027. The show is billed as a solo, full-band and John Mayer Trio presentation.

events.title: RECESS VEGAS 2027: The 10-Year Anniversary / Juneteenth Weekend
events.venueName: Location TBD / Planet Hollywood host hotel noted by organizer
events.summary: ARC CONCEPTS / Recess Getaways’ 10-year anniversary destination weekend over Juneteenth, billed as four days of parties, pool parties, theme events, special guests, networking, and group travel programming in Las Vegas.

events.title: A Perfect Circle with The Cult
events.venueName: BleauLive Theater at Fontainebleau Las Vegas
events.summary: A Perfect Circle performs a two-night Las Vegas run at BleauLive Theater on June 10 and 11, 2027. The venue page confirms special guest The Cult as opener.

events.title: Donny Osmond at Harrah's Las Vegas
events.venueName: Harrah's Showroom at Harrah's Las Vegas
events.summary: Representative June date for Donny Osmond's long-running Harrah's Las Vegas residency, which is extended through June 2027. The show is a career-spanning pop residency with hits and audience-request segments.

events.title: The Airborne Toxic Event
events.summary: The Airborne Toxic Event plays House of Blues Las Vegas on June 3, 2027, a rescheduled date from September 11, 2026. The official artist tour page lists the Las Vegas stop and venue.
